title: The Stillness
question: Today, can the narrator (grey eyes, battered brown felt hat) escape the buried house and reach the open air?
light: violet lightning from the west, black shadows
palette: Crimson red weed, slate grey, soot black, rubble brown, powder blue-grey, aluminium silver, glowing sky blue

pantry_empty.described: A narrow Victorian walk at a walking pace-in pantry runs at a walking pace south from a scullery doorway. Grey slate shelves rest on brick piers around the limewashed walls, with deal shelves above and a small perforated zinc vent high on the back wall. Crumbs scatter across the slate, dented biscuit-tin lids lie on the brick floor, and a smashed brown bottle sits in a dried stain. The brick floor carries dust and tiny plaster flakes. A red-tinged shaft from the scullery doorway falls across the nearest shelf and catches the bottle glass. The doorway occupies the north edge, while the vent anchors the far wall. Grey daylight through the doorway at the LEFT, deep shadow.

kitchen_red_weed.described: A small half-buried Victorian back kitchen occupies a broken square of red quarry tiles. The west wall carries a pale-green dresser with copper pans and tin vessels; the east wall holds a black-leaded range beneath coloured paper supplements; the north window is packed with dark garden mould and crossed by an uprooted drainpipe. At the south end, a fallen beam and broken bricks frame the triangular aperture. Fleshy crimson fronds span the aperture and tint the room with a blood-red half-light. Smashed crockery and plaster cover the floor, while blue-and-white tile-pattern wallpaper survives between cracks. Grey daylight through the window at the LEFT, deep shadow.

pit_abandoned.described: A vast circular pit opens below a north-rim mound of smashed brick, beams, plaster, clay, and gravel. Terraced yellow walls descend to a sandy floor marked by a smooth bluish-grey powder mound, bright aluminium bars, scattered white bones, and dark patches where birds gather. Crimson weed rises among the rubble at the rim and threads across the terraces. The far bank carries heaped mould and broken villa walls beneath a glowing blue sky. Violet light from the west grazes the powder and bars, throwing long black shadows toward the eastern terraces. Raking grey daylight from the LEFT, deep shadow.

sheen_ruins.described: The crest of a rubble mound overlooks the ruined suburb of Sheen. Smashed brickwork, clay, and gravel form the foreground, covered by knee-high crimson cactus-shaped plants and fine red threads. Roofless white-stucco and red-brick villas stand across the middle distance with walls broken at the second storey, windows smashed, doors shattered, and red weed filling their rooms. Dead brown trees rise near the pit, while living stems farther away carry red strands. A six-foot red-brick garden wall crosses the north-east distance. Glowing blue sky light falls from above and the west, sharpening every rubble edge. Raking grey daylight from the LEFT, deep shadow.

shots.turn: a sheer drop at his feet -> a practicable slope reaches the summit
shots.why: This picture answers the question: the narrator reaches the open air and gains a route above the buried house.

shots.frame: Wide landscape from the mound crest over Sheen's smashed brickwork, red weed, dead trees, and roofless villas.
shots.motion: The camera rises one whole yard above the rubble crest, looking down over the suburb; red weed sways across the foreground; distant branches lift in the breeze.
shots.camera: The camera stands on the mound crest at shoulder height, four yards from the nearest rubble, with a 35mm lens; blue sky light comes from ABOVE and WEST.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS the crimson weed across the mound at the CENTRE; roofless villas stand beyond at the TOP; dead brown trees rise at the LEFT and RIGHT; the garden wall marks the far BACK; the pit opens below the BOTTOM; red threads cross the distant branches. Smashed brickwork, clay and gravel lie beneath the weed in the near foreground, lit from the WEST.
shots.end: The weed-covered mound fills the foreground at the BOTTOM, roofless villas stretch across Sheen, dead trees stand at the LEFT and RIGHT, the garden wall holds the far BACK, and blue sky fills the TOP.
shots.crowd: 1 gaunt cat and several birds; the cat moves along the wall while birds pick through the rubble
shots.view: wide view from the summit over Sheen

sounds.sound: crows calling and wings beating over the pit

source: Now I stood on a mound of smashed brickwork, clay, and gravel, over which spread a multitude of red cactus-shaped plants, knee-high.
shots.turn: comfortable suburb -> red weed and broken masonry define Sheen
shots.why: The open view reveals the scale of the destruction and the price of the narrator's escape.

shots.frame: Insert on a shattered villa window frame packed with red weed, loose plaster, and a strip of broken wall.
shots.motion: The camera tracks laterally past the foreground window frame toward the red weed across the whole shot; the wind bends the red weed through the opening; the wind lifts a red thread along the dead branch.
shots.camera: The camera stands at waist height across the ruined street, eighteen inches from the window, with a 90mm lens; blue sky light comes from ABOVE and WEST.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS the shattered window frame at the CENTRE; red weed fills the opening; loose glass rests along the BOTTOM sill; plaster fragments mark the LEFT; a dead brown branch crosses the RIGHT; hard blue light reaches the TOP edge.
shots.end: The broken window frame fills the CENTRE, red weed presses through the opening, glass rests at the BOTTOM, plaster catches light at the LEFT, and the dead branch carries a red thread at the RIGHT.
shots.crowd: 1 gaunt cat moves along the nearby wall; wind stirs the rubble dust
shots.view: insert view of a shattered villa window and red weed

sounds.sound: loose shattered window glass settling among rubble

source: The neighbouring houses had all been wrecked, but none had been burned; their walls stood, sometimes to the second story, with smashed windows and shattered doors.
shots.turn: houses once sheltered life -> roofless rooms carry red weed
shots.why: The detailed ruin makes the title event tangible and shows the narrator seeing his former world remade.

shots.frame: Close on the narrator (grey eyes, sixteen days of grey-brown beard) breathing at the mound crest beneath the glowing blue sky.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in toward the narrator's face at the CENTRE; the narrator draws one breath; his shirt rises at the torn shoulder; red weed sways behind his face.
shots.camera: The camera stands at the narrator's eye height, one yard from his face, with a 75mm lens; blue sky light comes from ABOVE and WEST.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS the narrator's face at the CENTRE, his head half the frame's height; the battered brown felt hat frames his ash-grey hair at the TOP; red weed fills the lower BACK; blue sky crowns the frame; the torn shirt shoulder rests at the LEFT; the rubble crest reaches the BOTTOM.
shots.end: The narrator breathes beneath the blue sky, red weed sways behind him, his torn shirt lifts at the LEFT, the hat holds the TOP, and bright air fills the crest below.
shots.view: close view from the mound crest toward the open sky
source: And oh! the sweetness of the air!
shots.turn: buried breath -> open air fills the narrator
shots.why: The narrator's breath converts survival into sensation and gives the escape its human release.

shots.frame: Wide Sheen ruins beneath a glowing blue sky, crimson weed across rubble, roofless villas, dead trees, birds, and the distant cat.
shots.motion: The camera pans from the rubble to the stand, travelling two strides at a walking pace, across the whole shot; the breeze bends the crimson stems; birds move among the broken walls.
shots.camera: The camera stands on the mound crest at shoulder height, eight yards from the nearest rubble, with a 35mm lens; blue sky light comes from ABOVE and WEST.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS the crimson weed across the rubble at the CENTRE; roofless villas occupy the middle distance; dead trees stand at the LEFT; the glowing sky fills the TOP; birds move through broken rooms at the RIGHT; the gaunt cat crosses the far wall above the BOTTOM edge.
shots.end: Crimson weed bends over smashed rubble at the BOTTOM, roofless villas stand beneath the blue sky, birds move through broken rooms at the RIGHT, the cat reaches the far wall, and dead trees hold the LEFT horizon.
shots.crowd: 1 gaunt cat and several birds; birds hop among the ruins while the cat moves along the wall
shots.view: wide summit view over the ruined suburb
source: A gentle breeze kept the red weed that covered every scrap of unoccupied ground gently swaying. And oh! the sweetness of the air!
shots.turn: human escape -> the altered world gives its answer
shots.why: The world answers the escape with bright air, red weed, and a devastated landscape that outlasts the narrator's fear.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Bare shelves make hunger the day's first fact.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: The empty shelves close every road back to strength.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: I secure the door, then face the crumbs.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: I count the days by thirst, darkness, and failing strength.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: The narrator folds beside the dresser; thirst drains his strength.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: The dark scullery narrows around my thoughts of eating.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: I risk the pump; black rainwater revives my throat.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Water first. Fear can wait.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: The glass fills, and courage follows the quiet.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: The quiet after pumping gives me one small courage.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Dreams mingle food, escape, and the curate's death.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Thirst remains sharp.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Red fronds seal the opening, staining daylight like blood.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: A dog snuffles near him; its muzzle enters the gap.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Good dog!

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Come nearer, good dog.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: The animal withdraws. He listens beside the weeds. He grips the rubble and starts climbing.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Below, crows fight over bones in the emptied pit.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: He pushes through crimson growth onto the mound.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: An upward slope opens; he scrambles toward the summit.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Sheen spreads around him: broken brick, red weed, dead trees, roofless rooms.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Birds search the wreckage; a gaunt cat crosses a wall.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: And oh! the sweetness of the air!

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: The sky is open.

lines.speaker: curate
lines.text: The breeze moves the weed; the ruined world answers with light.
